title: تستضيفها قطر مجددًا.. الكشف عن مواعيد نهائيات كأس القارات للأندية 2026
summary: هل يحسم باريس سان جيرمان اللقب مجددًا؟

body: الوداد يقيل مدربه بعد 4 جولات فقط لم يصبر الوداد طويلاً.. 4 أسابيع فقط كانت كافية ليُسدل الستار على تجربة البرتغالي باولو سيرجيو، بعد بداية كارثية وضعت الفريق الأحمر مبكراً خارج حسابات المنافسة وأشعلت غضب جماهيره في مركب محمد الخامس. أعلن نادي الوداد الرياضي، اليوم الخميس، إنهاء ارتباطه رسمياً بمدربه البرتغالي باولو سيرجيو، بعد مرور 4 جولات فقط من انطلاق البطولة الاحترافية لموسم 2026-2027. ودخل الوداد الموسم الجديد بشعار وحيد هو العودة إلى منصات التتويج، لكن الحلم اصطدم بواقع مرير منذ الجولة الأولى، بعد السقوط المدوي بثلاثة أهداف لهدف أمام وداد تمارة. واستمر مسلسل النتائج السلبية، حيث اكتفى الفريق بتحقيق فوز وحيد في أول أربع مباريات، مقابل هزيمة وتعادلين، ليجمع 5 نقاط فقط من أصل 12 نقطة ممكنة، في حصيلة لا تليق بطموحات نادٍ بحجم الوداد. وأكد النادي في بيانه الرسمي عبر حساباته على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي، أنه "توصل إلى اتفاق يقضي بإنهاء الارتباط بالمدرب البرتغالي باولو سيرجيو وفسخ العقد الذي يجمع الطرفين بالتراضي"، موجهاً الشكر للمدرب على الفترة التي قضاها على رأس العارضة الفنية. وجاء قرار الإقالة مباشرة بعد التعادل المخيب أمام أمل تزنيت، الأحد الماضي، بمركب محمد الخامس بالدار البيضاء، وهي النتيجة التي فجرت غضب الجماهير الودادية. عقدة الدار البيضاء.. لا فوز على أرضه المفارقة الصادمة…

title: Sony Japan marks last standalone 4K Blu-ray player as ‘Discontinued’
summary: Sony is following the footsteps of LG in ending Blu-ray player production.
body: Blu-ray is fading after 20 years in the market, with Sony Japan finally discontinuing its last dedicated Blu-ray player. According to FlatpanelsHD , Sony Japan has finally marked the UBP-X700/K player as “Discontinued,” meaning customers in the country can no longer purchase a new standalone Blu-ray player from the company. This should not come as a surprise, as Sony stopped shipping the players in February of this year, suggesting that Sony only relied on existing inventory for its remaining Blu-ray player sales. The PlayStation 5 is the only remaining Sony device that can play Blu-ray discs, but the company has also announced that it will end physical game disc production by January 2028. Because of this, some people fear that the upcoming PlayStation 6 will no longer have an optical drive. This move follows in the footsteps of LG, which ended Blu-ray player production in 2024. summary: Despite all odds, the AI boom is increasing relevance of tape storage as technology enables cheap storage with zero power consumption in idle and ultimate security with air gap.
body: In a world where SSDs with up to 256TB capacity are about to enter the scene to compete against hard disk drives that store over 40TB, magnetic tape storage may seem archaic. However, the 25-year-old Linear Tape-Open (LTO) format continues to evolve at a rather impressive pace. The current LTO-10 generation stores up to 40TB of uncompressed data per cartridge, while HPE, IBM, and Quantum — the companies behind the LTO Program — now envision LTO-14 cartridges with up to 365TB of native capacity. But capacity is not the only advantage of LTO. In fact, the consortium has deliberately slowed its capacity roadmap in a bid to prioritize reliability, cost per terabyte, and manageable backup and recovery times over the previous goal of doubling capacity with every generation. LTO began in 2000 with the LTO-1 format, which stored just 100GB of data natively and transferred it at 20 MB/s. Since then, capacity increased to 200GB with LTO-2, 400GB with LTO-3, 800GB with LTO-4, 1.5TB with LTO-5, 2.5TB with LTO-6, 6TB with LTO-7, 12TB with LTO-8, and 18TB with LTO-9. body: SSD controller designer FADU’s new File-Semantic SSD (FS-SSD) was announced at the 2026 OCP Global Summit. The new device promises to move the file system into the SSD itself. As detailed in a white paper , this enables GPUs, DPUs, and NICs to open and read files with “no host filesystem, no block layer, and no storage-server CPU in the path.” FADU told Tom’s Hardware Premium it expects partner samples by Q3 2027. FADU is a Seoul, South Korea-based fabless SSD controller designer . Its FS-SSD technology is designed to handle and improve the control path, as the data path side moved to accelerators years ago. FADU’s measurements show that the file system, plus block layers, can consume about 30% of CPU cycles in a GPUDirect Storage (GDS) random-read workload. It notes that bypass options give up the files, and the company claims its solution promises the best of both worlds. In FADU’s own preliminary Network File System (NFS) over NVMe test, on a drive built on its FC6161 Gen6 controller in a PCIe 5.0 host, remote file throughput held steady as the server downshifted from what FADU labels 16 cores to just one, maintaining about 460,000 ops/s. title: Why you don't need an audiophile headset for gaming — comfort, convenience, and a good mic win over pure audio fidelity
summary: Headsets are mainly about audio, but that doesn't mean that the "objectively" best-sounding headset by audiophile standards translates to the best-sounding headset by gaming standards.
body: "Best gaming headset for audiophiles" is one of the categories on our list of best gaming headsets , and it's easy to look at that and wonder if you shouldn't be looking at just audiophile headsets to begin with. Headsets are mainly about audio, after all, and it does seem to logically follow that audiophile headsets would have the best audio (I mean, it's in the name). Well, not so fast. Headsets are mainly about audio, but that doesn't mean that the "objectively" best-sounding headset by audiophile standards translates to the best-sounding headset by gaming standards. Nor does it mean that you should choose your gaming headset based on audio quality at the expense of everything else. Audiophile headsets , including headphones, are primarily designed around one thing: audio fidelity. In other words, they're designed and tuned to reproduce audio exactly as it was recorded, which is exactly as the artist heard it when they were recording it, and is therefore exactly as the artist intended for it to be heard. title: Modern software is built on the backs of low-paid maintainers, opening the door to potential threats
summary: Modern computing remains vulnerable to the low bus factor of many open-source projects — continued lack of funding and manpower for voluntary-maintained infrastructure makes for a perennial threat
body: Modern computing systems and devices typically require pieces of crucial open-source software, typically maintained by unpaid or low-paid volunteers. Recently, a report collated a list of critical open-source projects, noting which of them are chronically underfunded and/or understaffed. The information is sobering: 11 out of 23 of the listed projects currently only have one or two maintainers, and funding is generally scarce and sometimes nonexistent. The Data Drop's report on open-source maintainers identifies that having only one or two sets of eyes on critical pieces of software means that sooner or later something breaks — and it tends to do so in spectacular fashion, given its ubiquity. So, what happens when these projects, which are widely used across software, go underfunded or understaffed? Lessons from the past In 2014, the same year as Heartbleed, Shellshock made waves: a vulnerability in the Bash shell that's present in Linux, macOS, and Unix-type systems.
